reload_SentenceEmbedder: reload a pretrained XLM model checkpoint into a SentenceEmbedder instance
get_embeddings: get sentence embeddings from input token tensors using the transformer model
get_parameters: get trainable parameters for a specified transformer layer range
set_eval_mode: set the SentenceEmbedder model to evaluation mode
move_to_cuda: move the SentenceEmbedder model to GPU device
